reply.text: That high a number isn't something I'd interpret for you — heart rate response is individual, and whether it's a fat-loss zone or just a hard effort depends on your max and fitness, not a flat number. What I can say generally: interval work at a hard-but-sustainable effort burns calories and builds conditioning regardless of the exact zone, so if the intervals felt controlled and you recovered fine, you're doing the work. If you're after specifics on your heart rate zones, that's worth checking with a doctor who can test or estimate your max properly. Want to talk through how your intervals are structured instead?
